lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
The maples shed their copper crowns
Beneath a sky of heavy gray
The garden path is turning brown
As summer shadows start to stray
[Pre-Chorus]
A hollow wind begins to moan
Across the fields of weathered stone
[Chorus]
The harvest moon is hanging low
Above the pines where shadows creep
I walk the ground where secrets grow
And keep the promises I keep
[Verse]
The rusted gate hangs on one hinge
Where the orchard meets the lane
Each morning frost leaves a silver fringe
Upon the fields of golden grain
[Pre-Chorus]
The river flows in steady lines
Through the tangle of the pines
[Chorus]
The harvest moon is hanging low
Above the pines where shadows creep
I walk the ground where secrets grow
And keep the promises I keep
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
A lantern light in a window pane
The steady rhythm of the falling rain
[Chorus]
The harvest moon is hanging low
Above the pines where shadows creep
I walk the ground where secrets grow
And keep the promises I keep
[Outro]
